district_name: Twin Valley Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(G) inventory: Twin Valley Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Windham Southwest Supervisory Union (member towns: Whitingham, Wilmington), formed under Act 156 (2019). Operates PK-12.

board.org_name: Twin Valley Unified Union School Board
board.post_note: Twin Valley UUSD: seven directors; director results are tallied per town (2025 Certificate of Votes) but the per-town allocation and each member's town are unconfirmed from official sources (Articles of Agreement not located) -- modeled as one post with the allocation flagged in the sources.

sources.note: WSWSU TVUUSD board page (official, fetched 2026-10-22): the seven directors with published terms/expirations -- Corey (Chair) 2028, Larsen (Vice Chair) 2028, Hartnett (Clerk) 2027, Kingsley 2027, Dornburgh 2027, Bullock 2029, Haeckel (1-year term) 2027 -- the same seven who signed the FY27 warning (Jan. 21, 2026) and attended the March 18, 2026 reorganization (no turnover at the March 3, 2026 election). Election mechanics: the FY27 warning's Article V elects 3 directors for 3-year terms by Australian ballot; the district's March 4, 2025 Certificate of Votes refers director results to the two towns' own returns ("See Town of Wilmington and Town of Whitingham results") -- per-town tallying consistent with the proportional model. FLAGS: (1) the per-town seat allocation (news reports Whitingham 3, implying Wilmington 4) and each member's town are established by no fetched official source -- the Articles of Agreement are the resolving document, so the board is modeled as ONE post; (2) Haeckel's 1-year term: the FY27 warning warned only 3-year seats, and whether he was elected in March 2026 to a 1-year remainder (the pattern the 2025 certificate documents) or appointed is unestablished -- minted ELECTED off the current roster with this flag; the towns' March 3, 2026 returns resolve both flags.

directors.name: John Haeckel
directors.note: Published on a 1-year term expiring 2027 -- see Flag 2 in the board sources.
